_approach: Dariacore 'draws inspiration from plunderphonics and mashcore' (Wikipedia) — genres built from splicing unrelated recordings together — and the genre's own reputation is for 'abrupt key/tempo shifts' from one bar to the next. This groove makes the splice literal: bar 1 is a plain four-on-the-floor house pattern, bar 2 is an unrelated syncopated breakbeat, with no transition between them, as if two different songs' drum tracks were spliced end to end — the drum-only analogue of dariacore's sample-flip whiplash.
